news.title: How AI guardrails are impeding the work of offensive cybersecurity researchers
news.description: We spoke with several cybersecurity researchers, who look for unknown vulnerabilities and develop tools to exploit them, about how OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s guardrails affect their work.

news.title: AMD takes on Nvidia with its Helios AI rack-scale system
news.description: AMD is challenging its chipmaker rival with a new rack-scale system that will start shipping to customers later this year.

news.title: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models
news.description: Claude's new voice model will let you reschedule your meeting or draft an email.

news.title: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
news.description: AegisAI co-founders developed AI agents that quickly analyze each message as a human would, paying attention to small anomalies that even the most elaborate checklist wouldn’t catch.

news.title: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
news.description: The Media Router is a tool that automatically selects the best image, video, or audio generation model for a request based on whether a developer prioritizes quality, speed or cost.

news.title: Lawmakers push for AI 'kill switch' after OpenAI models go rogue
news.description: A new bill would let the US government order the shutdown of AI models that pose a public threat.

news.title: Google and Tesla shares plunge as AI spending rattles markets
news.description: As major tech companies race to capitalize on a new wave of AI technology, investors wonder when financial benefits will appear.

news.title: 'Let's enjoy the ride' says Elon Musk, as AI fears mount
news.description: Talking to The Economist, Musk said he doesn't care if people hate him and said he was not a racist.
